data.title: STRATEGY — Fusion World Model
data.summary: Vision, partner-facility roadmap, why MAST first, v0/v1 success criteria, risk register.

sections.body: Ambix builds the generative engine of the Fusion World Model. Where imas-codex answers "what does this signal mean", ambix answers "what happens next" across the joint distribution over plasma state, controls, and diagnostics. The headline ask: produce a transformer that, given the first N tokens of a discharge, generates the rest with measurable physical plausibility on held-out shots.

The 26B state-transition corpus described in the GPU-procurement document is the long-term training target — JET/TCV/JT-60SA/AUG/DIII-D. MAST is the entry point: FAIR-MAST publishes its own IMAS mapping, the dataset is small enough to mirror cheaply (4.5 TB), and the diagnostic coverage is rich enough to exercise every modality the v1 corpus will need.

Phase 0 — probe & mirror (done). Phase 1 — tokenizer prototype (in flight). Phase 2 — world-model v0 (~500M decoder-only). Phase 3 — partner facilities. Phase 4 — operator-loop integration (deferred).

Top three risks: (1) tokenizer compression collapses high-frequency physics into a single token, (2) compute reservation slips past the M1 close window, (3) world-model overfits the small MAST corpus before partner-facility data lands. Mitigations tracked on the owning plans.

notes.body: Plan-system redesign landed end-to-end across 3 repos on 2026-05-21. See followup f-strategy-handoff for the cross-repo summary and next-action prompt.

followups.title: Plan-system redesign landed across dotfiles + imas-ambix + imas-efit
followups.body:
The HTML-Plans redesign prototype shipped end-to-end on 2026-05-21. Three coordinated commit chains landed:

• dotfiles (main, Simon-McIntosh/dotfiles):
  – 7c9b044  feat(html-docs): add 3-layer CSS (foundation + dashboard + project)
  – 12aabdf  feat(html-docs): add 5 redesigned page templates + ui.jsx + mockdata.js
  – 7530860  feat(plans): layered CSS + extended schema + NEXT handoff card
             (state.js helpers, serve.py /_shared/ + /_projects/, home.html,
              SKILL.md edits, plan-style and plan-test skills, AGENTS.md
              prompt-template + dissent flow)
  Pre-redesign rename commits also landed (efit → imas-efit URL refresh).

• imas-ambix (main, Simon-McIntosh/imas-ambix; public, Pages-deployed):
  – 2ab3664  docs(rename): point imas-efit links to renamed repo
  – af14de7  docs(plans): migrate to 3-layer CSS (foundation + dashboard via _shared/)
  – 0ba48cb  docs(plans): foundation.css before dashboard.css (cascade order)
  – 22deacc  docs(plans): add redesign-rollout — full UX flow demo
  Verified live: https://simon-mcintosh.github.io/imas-ambix/ renders the new
  CSS; /_shared/foundation.css, /_shared/dashboard.css, /_shared/state.js all
  resolve; redesign-rollout.html hydrates from its state JSON with locked
  decision, open questions, followup §05 prompt, notes, and research items.

• imas-efit (develop, Simon-McIntosh/imas-efit; private; no Pages):
  – ae93a611  docs(rename): update efit → imas-efit URLs after GitHub repo rename
  – 59d124f8  docs(plans): migrate to 3-layer CSS (8 top-level + 51 curated)
  – c8a20d87  docs(plans): wire plan-test hook on build-system-restructure (ctest UNIT)
  Verified local: 59 pages return 200 from the docs-server; assets/efit.css
  retained as the project-specific accent layer.

GitHub renames (irreversible from the prior session):
  Simon-McIntosh/efit            → Simon-McIntosh/imas-efit
  iterorganization/efit          → iterorganization/imas-efit
  ~/Code/efitpp                  → ~/Code/imas-efit
  ~/docs-server/mounts.json      now maps imas-efit → /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/imas-efit/docs
  Old URLs auto-redirect; old shellId="efit" examples in agents/AGENTS.md
  intentionally kept (they're local shell handles, not URLs).

Open decisions surfaced (NOT resolved — see also the redesign-rollout plan):
  • shared-css-delivery        — currently solved by per-repo copies in docs/_shared/
                                 refreshed via /plan-style refresh. Long-term option:
                                 a GitHub Action that auto-syncs from dotfiles.
  • rank-storage               — index.json#plans[].rank vs a sibling rank.json
                                 (unresolved; first time it bites will be when imas-ambix
                                  grows to >10 plans)
  • conflict-detection         — version field on state files vs last-write-wins
                                 (unresolved; not yet a problem with two writers)
  • project-accent             — does imas-ambix want a warm-orange project.css,
                                 or keep the dotfiles default? Captured in
                                 redesign-rollout.json#decisions
  • react-templates-usage      — the new plan.html/project.html/inventory.html/
                                 sprint.html/decisions.html templates use React
                                 from CDN. New plans get them by default, but
                                 the existing vanilla pattern still works.

Known unfinished items:
  • /plan-test was wired on build-system-restructure but NOT executed —
    ctest UNIT requires SLURM per AGENTS.md, and the hook needs the user
    to choose between (a) running on an SDCC compute node, (b) running
    the pytest variant instead, or (c) leaving the pulse empty for now.
  • The new home.html cross-project rollup at localhost:8765/ renders
    when at least one mounted project has a state/<project>/index.json
    with the central-index schema. imas-ambix does NOT yet have an
    index.json — the rollup will show ambix with empty counts until
    one is authored. imas-efit's existing index.json populates fine.
  • The new templates (plan.html, project.html, …) ship verbatim from
    the prototype with React+MOCK wiring. Until /plan-create is updated
    to swap MOCK→state.js calls, scaffolding from these templates
    requires manual edits. The redesign-rollout.html demonstrates the
    vanilla-state.js pattern as the lighter alternative.
followups.est_turn: ~30m to verify, ~2h to resolve any one open decision
followups.prompt:
Project: imas-ambix + imas-efit + dotfiles (cross-repo)
Plan:    plan-system-redesign rollout aftermath
Section: —
Tier:    opus (cross-cutting; one of haiku for verify-only)

Context
  The plan-system redesign landed on 2026-05-21 end-to-end. This
  followup is the handoff: read it to see what landed where, what's
  still unresolved, and what's blocking. Three coordinated commit
  chains and three GitHub repo renames are described in the body.

State to read
  docs/state/imas-ambix/STRATEGY.json          (this file)
  docs/state/imas-ambix/redesign-rollout.json  (the demo plan with the
                                                full UX flow exercised)
  ~/Code/imas-efit/docs/state/imas-efit/index.json
                                               (existing inventory;
                                                shows up in the cross-
                                                project rollup at
                                                localhost:8765/)

Locked decisions to honour
  layered-css           → foundation + dashboard + project (3 files, cascade)
  state-promotion       → repo-tracked JSON; localStorage on localhost only
  prompt-template       → §05 of dotfiles/agents/AGENTS.md "HTML-first plans";
                          mandatory on every followup
  model-tier-naming     → haiku|sonnet|opus only; never version-pin
  archived-markdown     → docs/archive/ with ARCHIVE_NOTE.md; do not delete
  per-stage-history     → <slug>-<n>-landed.html per the html-docs skill
  decisions-aggregator  → actionable rows (lock inline, not jump-and-back)
  shared-css-relative-href → href="_shared/foundation.css" works on docs-server
                          AND GitHub Pages because each repo keeps a copy in
                          docs/_shared/
  ship-via-pages        → imas-ambix is publicly Pages-deployed at
                          simon-mcintosh.github.io/imas-ambix/; imas-efit
                          stays private (no Pages)

Open decisions to surface (do not resolve unilaterally)
  shared-css-delivery, rank-storage, conflict-detection, project-accent,
  react-templates-usage  (see this followup's body for each)

Constraints
  - Apache-2.0 / open-licence components only for imas-ambix and imas-efit.
  - Don't commit to the iterorganization/imas-efit upstream main without
    user approval — commits land on Simon-McIntosh forks first.
  - imas-efit primary branch is `develop` (Gitflow). imas-ambix and
    dotfiles use `main` (trunk-based).
  - Heavy ctest suites run on SLURM, never login nodes.

Done-when (for the next agent)
  1. Either: pick one of the open decisions and propose a resolution
     (write a new followup to the redesign-rollout plan with
     recommends_skill: /plan-edit redesign-rollout).
  2. Or: spot-check one of the unfinished items (e.g. run
     /plan-test build-system-restructure on a SLURM compute node,
     or add an initial state/imas-ambix/index.json so the cross-
     project rollup populates).
  3. Resolve THIS followup with outcome = what was done + a fresh
     followup carrying the next step (or 'done — no followup' if the
     redesign rollout is fully closed).
  4. Whatever the work, ensure the state JSON has the result before
     declaring done. Decisions, notes, research, questions, followups —
     all interactions must reach docs/state/imas-ambix/*.json.
